svg.text: Pan & Lid Drawer Storage - nested layout

3/8" baltic birch, parts run along the 35 side. Padding 0.25" minimum at the sheet edges (0.250" at the near edges of the strips), 0.227273" between parts; part height 3.75" (12 rows). Tab height 1.75". Tabbed parts alternate 180 degrees so the tab steps interlock.
Totals: 2 supports, 4 rail outer plies, 4 rail inner plies, 7 divider A (12 7/8" gap), 7 divider B (9 7/8" gap).
Cut order (cut file colours): 1 red = dowel holes, 2 blue = fingered parts (supports, rail inner plies), 3 green = plain parts (rail outer plies, dividers).
Layout check passed: no overlaps; smallest gap between parts 0.227" (min 0.227273"), smallest edge padding 0.250" (min 0.25").
Sheet 1 of 1 - 48" x 34" (2 x SUPPORT, 4 x RAIL INNER, 4 x RAIL OUTER, 7 x DIVIDER A, 7 x DIVIDER B)
